name: North Temperate Lakes LTER Lake Mendota water temperature observations
resolution: daily, 0.5 m depth increments to 25 m depth
access: Collected from North Temperate Lakes Long-Term Ecological Research Program (NSF DEB-1440297); see Read et al. [2019] for data access

scales.note: 1D profile observations at Lake Mendota (approx. 40 km^2 surface area, ~6.3 km equivalent extent). Total duration from April 2, 1980 to December 30, 2014 (12,691 days).
